content_quality.evidence: The crawl found 609 valuable candidates and 7 thin classifications. Manual inspection confirmed expanded CodeLab and case-study content, but this is not a human quality review of all indexable pages.

technical_accessibility.evidence: Robots and sitemap returned HTTP 200; 594 sitemap candidates were parsed; no broken responses, blocked URLs, or malformed same-host links were reported. HTTP/host variants and confirmed duplicate service routes redirect permanently.

navigation_and_user_experience.evidence: The site has global navigation, legal/footer links, working contact paths, and multiple learning routes. Mobile, keyboard, and end-to-end form behavior were not tested.

trust_and_transparency.evidence: Privacy, terms, and disclaimer pages are linked; Contact provides phone, email, location, service area, hours, and response expectations. Accuracy of claims and AdSense account disclosures needs owner verification.

indexing_hygiene.evidence: Preferred service URLs are canonical and in the sitemap; query-filter and utility variants are generally canonicalized or noindex. Eleven noindex utility routes lack canonical declarations, with no change indicated.

mobile_usability.evidence: Responsive layouts are present in the application, but no browser viewport, touch interaction, or performance assessment was run.

limitations: The crawl's Valuable and Thin labels are triage signals, not AdSense policy classifications.
Playwright rendering and authenticated routes were not inspected.
AdSense account status, site ownership review, and Policy Center cannot be verified from public pages.
recommendation: Complete browser review of representative monetized lessons and articles, verify the AdSense consent configuration for applicable regions, and confirm policy and business details before requesting review.
